files.description: Primary EHI export documentation. 4-page PDF describing single-patient export (PDF output) and all-patient bulk export (XLSX workbook + per-patient CCD/PDF/RTF files in a ZIP). Lists 18 worksheet names in the bulk export XLSX and 7 per-patient file types. No field-level data dictionary. Created Oct 18, 2023 by Lisa Davies.

HappyFox KB article page (HTML). Article body is minimal: 'Please see attached file for Explanation of the File Format for a Single Patient Export and All Patients Export'. The PDF attachment contains all substantive content. Tags: b 10, CURES, 170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information export, Export, patient charts.
